title: Hateful People or Hateful Bots? Detection and Characterization of Bots Spreading Religious Hatred in Arabic Social Media
reasoning: The paper focuses specifically on identifying and characterizing the spread of religious hatred on social media. It analyzes content targeting specific religious groups (such as Jews, Atheists, and Shia) and includes topic models evaluating religious content like 'Islamic Supplications' and 'Political/Jew' themes.
